findings.title: Waterings page crashes on a malformed list response; navigation silently stays on the previous page
findings.expected: Waterings page opens and shows an error that the waterings could not be loaded
findings.actual: Uncaught 'waterings.value?.reduce is not a function'; URL changes to /waterings but the Beds page stays rendered with no error shown
findings.evidence: {"url":"/waterings","headings":["Beds","Add a bed","All beds","North bed","Shade corner"],"alerts":[],"pageErrors":["waterings.value?.reduce is not a function"]} | {"url":"/waterings","headings":["Beds","Add a bed","All beds","North bed","Shade corner"],"alerts":[],"pageErrors":["waterings.value?.reduce is not a function"]}

findings.title: Dashboard renders a malformed waterings response as rows of 'Never' with blank bed and amount
findings.expected: An error saying recent waterings could not be loaded
findings.actual: Table of rows reading 'Never', empty bed, '–', and no alert
findings.evidence: {"section":["Recent waterings","All waterings","The five most recent waterings","WHEN\tBED\tAMOUNT","Never\t\t–","Never\t\t–","Never\t\t–","Never\t\t–","Never\t\t–","Never\t\t–"],"alerts":[]} | {"section":["Recent waterings","All waterings","The five most recent waterings","WHEN\tBED\tAMOUNT","Never\t\t–","Never\t\t–","Never\t\t–","Never\t\t–","Never\t\t–","Never\t\t–"],"alerts":[]}

findings.title: Dashboard shows 'No waterings yet' when the waterings response is not a list
findings.expected: A visible load error, because waterings exist
findings.actual: Empty state 'No waterings yet' with no error, so a failed load looks like an empty log
findings.evidence: {"section":["Recent waterings","All waterings","No waterings yet","Use “Water now” on a bed to record one.","Go to beds","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"],"alerts":[]} | {"section":["Recent waterings","All waterings","No waterings yet","Use “Water now” on a bed to record one.","Go to beds","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"],"alerts":[]}

findings.title: Past-watering form accepts amounts under 0.005 L, then shows and lists them as '0 L'
findings.expected: Amount below the field's 0.1 L minimum is refused, or at least shown as a non-zero amount
findings.actual: 0.004 L is saved, and the confirmation reads 'Recorded 0 L on 8 Nov 2026.'; the list shows '0 L'
findings.evidence: {"created":1,"alerts":["Recorded 0 L on 8 Nov 2026."],"newest":{"id":6,"bed_id":2,"bed_name":"Shade corner","watered_on":"2026-11-08","watered_at":null,"litres":0.004}} | {"created":1,"alerts":["Recorded 0 L on 8 Nov 2026."],"newest":{"id":6,"bed_id":2,"bed_name":"Shade corner","watered_on":"2026-11-08","watered_at":null,"litres":0.004}}

findings.title: No way to retry after the waterings list fails to load, short of reloading
findings.expected: A Try again control (or similar) next to the load error
findings.actual: Only the error text is shown; no retry button, and picking the same filter again sends no request
